title: Pricier PCs and AI-led buying: we must win on value and visibility
summary: Asus sees the 2027 PC market shrinking 10-15% on memory costs; SK Hynix locked over half of 2027-28 capacity, Phison 70% of 2027 NAND. Amazon opened text-to-shop Alexa, OpenAI lets brands claim ChatGPT profiles, JD.com bid for Ceconomy's MediaMarkt.

points.headline: Memory and NAND squeeze sets up a smaller, pricier 2027 PC market
points.detail: Asus forecasts a 10-15% PC market decline in 2027 as memory prices surge; SK Hynix has locked over half of 2027-28 capacity and Phison 70% of 2027 NAND, while some OEMs trim memory orders. We should secure supply and plan pricing now.

points.headline: AI assistants are becoming a buying channel, now with rules attached
points.detail: Amazon opened text-to-shop via Alexa, OpenAI lets businesses claim ChatGPT profiles, and Salesforce expects holiday shoppers to lean on agents; an EU draft ties agent autonomy to incentives. We should claim and test our presence there.

points.headline: Electronics channels reshape around ownership, memberships and value tiers
points.detail: JD.com is bidding for Ceconomy to lead European electronics retail; Amazon pushes Cyber 5 exclusives with AI personalization and surfaces Haul in search; TikTok Shop pilots paid membership. We should revisit channel terms and placement.

points.headline: Holiday demand holds up, but shoppers plan purchases and lean on credit
points.detail: Visa forecasts US holiday spending up 4.5% and UK Black Friday up 3%, yet 47% of online shoppers mainly buy planned items at big sales and BNPL use spans income brackets. We should pair clear value with instalment options.

points.headline: Small-business buyers are the contested front for AI-ready hardware
points.detail: Dell introduced Pro Essential, a design built for small business, as data shows 60% of small-business AI users get more done without adding staff. We should sharpen SMB bundles, AI-ready specs and financing on our business storefront.
